propositions: Read-only derivations over gate sidecars must compute llm_call_proxy and latency by summing REVIEW_RESULT.metrics.llm_calls only, never from COMPLETION_VERDICT which carries no metrics block.
cost_per_accepted_change is calculated as summed llm_calls divided by count of completion_verifier_pass_v1 records, returning None when zero accepted closes exist.
first_pass_verification computes the fraction of tickets whose earliest (oldest-first) COMPLETION_VERDICT record is a completion_verifier_pass_v1.

env_diagnosis_interval pairs each gate_error_v1 ERROR with the next PASS record matching the same gate field (plan_review, code_review, or completion), with interval calculated as PASS timestamp minus ERROR timestamp, or left open if no matching PASS follows.
The reader performs a single raw ordered scan of event files per ticket sorted by event_sort_key, reading schema and verdict from event data, without using reducer-cached helpers.
Metrics must register into registry.py with source="sidecar" and confidence="high" as authoritative derivations.
